title: Decide: close F-006 on the provisional Mac-only placement or authorize the auditor-route checks
goal: The owner either accepts the still-provisional recommendation after F-006-T23 to F-006-T31 and F-006 closes, or authorizes the live checks that keep mac-coder-mini-auditor at insufficient evidence
acceptance: The owner's decision is recorded in the F-006 record with its date
If accepted: F-006 closes on its existing Check, recording the auditor-route unknowns and that the Claude path and the Pi route rest on tests only (no live paid call, no live Pi run)
If authorized: the unavailable-Mac, cancellation and uncertain-outcome checks on the mac-coder-mini-auditor route become their own agent steps with estimates before any model call
privacy: A decision only; no model call, device or service change.
validation: The decision and date are in the record
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Opened 2026-11-26 from the fresh-context review of the F-006 closure: every Check clause has evidence, but the recommendation stays provisional (src/placement-report.ts: the auditor comparison is insufficient), and F-006-T22 framed closing on a provisional result as the owner's choice.
